text:
maria: Quick sanity check — cutoff is ~48h from now. Need coordinated version updates across api, runtime, console, and sdks. Can owners confirm changelogs, lockfiles, and compat matrix are being updated? Also we need a single canonical release date anchor (e.g. release: 2026-03-20). cc @kevin @sam @jen @alex
kevin: runtime update: kv-cache API is additive (new optional args + response field). I think this qualifies as a minor bump (0.18.x -> 0.19.0). I'll add a compatibility test and CHANGELOG entry tonight. No breaking changes.
sam: api side: only a small telemetry flag fix — will do a patch (2.4.0 -> 2.4.1). OpenAPI diff is trivial but it will change generated clients. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-api/pull/412 — will re-run codegen after runtime PR lands.
jen: console: UI needs a guard for the kv-cache toggle that checks runtime >=0.19. We'll ship console 1.12.0 (minor) once SDKs expose the new option. Console e2e currently flaky on staging — holding on final cut until green.
alex: sdks: planning releases — py-sdk 0.27.0, ts-sdk 3.5.0. Need API client regen after sam's PR and runtime feature flag available for integration tests. Windows CI flaky; I'll try to unblock today. I can publish prerelease artifacts (github packages) for console canary.
release-bot: CI update: api/integration ⏳, runtime/build ✅, console/e2e ❌ (3 failing flakes). See https://ci.redwood/2254/status
maria: If console e2e is failing we should not cut final console release. Proposal: use prerelease SDK artifacts for console canary, once canary e2e passes we'll update lockfiles and cut final releases. Also let's have a single changelog anchor line across repos: "release: 2026-03-20" — makes automation easier.
kevin: I'll add a runtime /version endpoint that returns {version, schema_version, features}. That will allow console and SDKs to gate behavior without parsing semver. PR #834 incoming.
sam: pushed a tiny schema change, regenerated server stubs. CC @alex — you'll need to regenerate clients after kevin's runtime PR merges.
alex: plan: regenerate clients from api master once runtime PR is merged, cut prerelease tag (alpha) for both py and ts so console can test. I'll add a workflow to publish to github packages with tag prerelease-rc.
jen: Can console use prerelease artifacts without touching npm/pypi? Prefer not to publish public packages yet. GitHub packages + yarn/npm install from registry should work.
alex: yep — will set up GH packages. Also adding a compat-matrix.md in sdks and console roots listing minimal versions (runtime >=0.19, api >=2.4.1, sdks >= listed).
dave: tiny ops note — please avoid changing the top-level yarn.lock in console until sdks are final. Lockfile updates cause downstream CI churn. If you must, do it in a follow-up PR with the compatibility tag.
maria: Good call. Flow decision: 1) runtime PR + /version endpoint -> merge, 2) regen clients and publish prerelease sdks, 3) console canary against prerelease sdks, 4) once console e2e green, update lockfiles + cut final releases. Everyone open PRs today and tag with label release/cutoff-48h?
kevin: Confirm — opening runtime PR and adding release/cutoff-48h label. :thumbsup:
sam: Confirm — will open patch PR and label.
alex: Confirm — will regenerate clients and publish prereleases, add compat doc.
jen: Confirm — I'll hold final console cut until e2e green and will add guard checks.
dave: noted, will monitor lockfile changes in CI and revert if necessary.
maria: Thanks. One more ask: include a short compat note in each CHANGELOG entry like "requires runtime >=0.19 for kv-cache feature" so automation can scrape it.
kevin: will include it.
release-bot: release-bot: reminder — release window locks in 36h. Label PRs asap.
maria: tagging for visibility: @release-manager @eng-oncall. If any blocker pops up, drop into #incidents. Otherwise we'll reconvene here after runtime PR merges. :rocket:
